scripts.build: bun --cwd ../../packages/contracts build && bun --cwd ../../packages/sdk generate && bun run build:pages
scripts.build:local: VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-local VITE_BASE_PATH=/pledge-cash/ VITE_PLEDGE_CASH_CHAIN_ID=31337 VITE_PLEDGE_CASH_CHAIN_NAME='pledge.cash local' VITE_PLEDGE_CASH_RPC_URL=/pledge-cash/rpc VITE_PLEDGE_CASH_EXPLORER_URL= VITE_PLEDGE_CASH_EXPLORER_NAME=Local bun run build
scripts.copy:pages: OUT_DIR="${VITE_OUT_DIR:-dist}"; mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR/deployments" && cp CNAME .nojekyll "$OUT_DIR/" && if compgen -G '../../packages/contracts/deployments/*.json' > /dev/null; then cp ../../packages/contracts/deployments/*.json "$OUT_DIR/deployments/"; else printf '%s\n' '{"status":"pending","reason":"Broadcast artifact not published yet"}' > "$OUT_DIR/deployments/998.json"; fi
